en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a river steamboat in the foreground and a large hilltop castle complex with massive walls and several wings in the background. Below the castle, small houses and riverside buildings line the bank. To the right, a prominent church with a tall, steep‑roofed nave and spire rises above the town. The image surface shows age‑related scratches and cracks, suggesting an early photographic print.
